payload.title: Doctor and Ward Nurse infection reports lack an authorized operation selector
payload.actual: On DEV demo.doctor and demo.nurse can read GET /infection-cases and have the report journey, but both receive 403 FORBIDDEN from the operation selector specified in InfectionCaseIn.booking_id. The two screen bundles list the report response itself as the only path source for SSI checks. A reporter cannot select an operation for an initial surgical-site report or independent wound check from that source.
payload.expected: Supply a permitted, scoped operation picker or opened_on hand-off for both reporter screens, and name it in the bundle. Report infection rules require the operation and depth for SurgicalSite, and allow a wound check to open its own case.
payload.evidence: GET /infection/ssi-surveillance: demo.doctor 403 f0623ed34dad4189a7bdba882019a017; demo.nurse 403 8eeaeae7ab0a494aa2f1e47339746440; demo.ipc 200 1374ebc9c77c40ffa93839dda8f7314c. GET /infection-cases: doctor 200 ae261f65fe1d4c97863370d3564559da, nurse 200 917379888cd2443d9e04aef5ba56c763. No patient or mutation used.
